name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois discovered his passion for motorsport through his father, a mechanic for a local rally team. This early exposure ignited a lifelong fascination with the technical intricacies of racing. He honed his skills at several smaller teams, mastering the art of race strategy under pressure. Jean-Pierre values meticulous planning and data analysis, believing that a well-prepared strategy is crucial for success. 

His approach emphasizes minimizing risks and maximizing opportunities. He excels at adapting strategies to unforeseen circumstances during a race, often making split-second decisions that can turn the tide. His distinctive analytical mind and ability to remain calm under pressure make him a valuable asset to any racing team.

Having spent years in various roles, Jean-Pierre brings a blend of experience and fresh perspectives to the Carlin Academy. He is committed to training and mentoring younger team members.

physical.description: A man of average height, Jean-Pierre has a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas during races.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee before every strategy session.
